Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:10:1.english: Lekavetz the roads - To clear thorns that are in the roads.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:10:2.hebrew: מרגילין להיות בתוכו ארבעים סאה - שמרגילין שיהא נוגע במקוה אמת המים, כדי שיהא בו ארבעים סאה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:10:2.english: They direct [water] so that there be forty se'ah in it - For they direct [the water] so that a water channel touches the mikveh, in order that there be forty se'ah in it.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:11:1.english: Any blood that is shed there - For example, by thorns on the roads.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:12:1.hebrew: הא - דקאמרת דלאתויי הני, נמי בהדיא קתני במתני': מתקנין כו'. אלא ודאי, הא דקתני ועושין כל צורכי רבים, לאתויי חפירה קא אתו:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:12:1.english: This - [thing] that you say [it comes] to include these [cases] is also explicitly taught in the Mishnah: "One may repair, etc." Rather, certainly, that which it teaches, "and one may tend to all public needs," comes to include digging [new cisterns].

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:13:1.hebrew: מציינין את הקברות - שעושין סימנים על הקברות בסיד, כדאמר במרובה (ב"ק דף סט.): של קברות בסיד דחוור כעצמות, כדי שלא ילכו אוכלי תרומה לשם:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:13:1.english: One may mark the graves - That they make signs on the graves with lime, as it says in [chapter] Merubah (Bava Kamma 69a): [the marking] of graves is with lime, because it is white like bones, so that those who eat terumah will not go there.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:13:2.hebrew: דכתיב וראה עצם וכו' - יחזקאל מתנבא על העתיד לבא שיעשו ישראל ציונים על עצמות הפגרים המושלכין. ורמז הוא, שלא בא הכתוב אלא להזהיר וללמד שיהא אדם עושה ציון:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:13:2.english: As it is written: “And [any] see a bone,” etc. - Ezekiel prophesies about the future to come, that Israel will make markers over the bones of the corpses cast about. And it is an allusion, for the verse came only to warn and to teach that a person should make a marker.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:14:1.hebrew: כל בן נכר וערל בשר - שמתו אחיו מחמת מילה ולא רצו למולו, שיראים פן ימות גם הוא כאחיו. לא יבא אל מקדשי לשרתני — שאסורין בעבודה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:14:1.english: No stranger... or uncircumcised in flesh - [This refers to one] whose brothers died because of circumcision, and they did not want to circumcise him, as they are afraid lest he too die like his brothers. "[He] shall not enter into My Sanctuary to serve Me" — [meaning] that they are forbidden from [performing the Temple] service.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:15:1.english: They learned [it] as a tradition - From Sinai.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:16:1.hebrew: טומאה קוראה לו פרוש - כלומר, עושים סימנים על הטומאה כדי שיהא מרגיש ופורש:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:16:1.english: Impurity cries out to him: Separate [yourself] - That is to say, they make markings over the impurity so that [a person] will notice [it] and separate [himself].

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:19:1.hebrew: לפני עור לא תתן מכשול - כלומר, עשו דבר על הטומאה, שלא יהו נכשלים בה נושאי תרומה וטהרות:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:19:1.english: Before the blind you shall not put a stumbling block - That is to say, make something [as a sign] over the ritual impurity, so that those who carry terumah and ritually pure foods will not stumble upon it.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:1:1.english: Damaged water [cisterns] - For example, stones that fell from [the wall of] the cistern.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:21:1.english: And you shall separate - And we translate [it into Aramaic as] vetafreshun [“and you shall separate”].

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:21:2.hebrew: עשו משמרת למשמרתי - עשו משמרת לאוכלי תרומה, דכתיב בה משמרת, דכתיב (במדבר י״ח:ח׳) ואני נתתי לך את משמרת תרומותי, שלא יהו מטמאים:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:21:2.english: Establish a safeguard for My charge - Establish a safeguard for those who eat teruma, regarding which "charge" is written, as it is written (Numbers 18:8): "And I have given you the charge of My terumot," so that they do not become ritually impure.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:23:1.english: And sets a way - That they make a sign [indicating] which way they should go.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:23:2.hebrew: אראנו בישע אלהים - זה השם אורחותיו, המחשב הפסד מצוה כנגד שכרה, ושכר עבירה כנגד הפסדה. ושם, כמו שמין:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:23:2.english: I will show him the salvation of God - This [refers to] the one who appraises his ways, who calculates the loss [incurred by] a mitzvah against its reward, and the reward of a transgression against its loss. And sham [is] like shamin [appraising].

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:24:1.hebrew: בשבתא דריגלא לא הוה מקשי ליה - משום דאתו כולי עלמא לפירקא, ואי מקשי ליה ולא הוה מצי לפרוקי, הוה מכסיף:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:24:1.english: On Shabbat of a Festival, he would not raise difficulties to him - Because everyone would come to the [public] lecture, and if he raised a difficulty to him and he were not able to resolve [it], he would be embarrassed.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:3:1.hebrew: חוטטין - נפלו צרורות בקרקעית הבור, מעלה אותן במועד:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:3:1.english: One may clean out - [If] pebbles fell to the bottom of the cistern, one may bring them up on the [intermediate days of the] Festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:5:1.hebrew: אבל לא חוטטין אותן - אי אמרת בשלמא הא דקתני ההיא ברייתא שלמעלה של יחיד, היינו בשיחיד צריך לו, איכא לאוקמי האי דקתני האי ברייתא אבל לא חוטטין בשאין יחיד צריך לו. אלא אי אוקמת לה הא דחוטטין בשאין יחיד צריך לו, א"כ האי דקתני אבל לא חוטטין במאי מוקמת לה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:5:1.english: But one may not clean them out - Granted, if you say [that] that which that baraita above teaches [regarding] "of an individual" is where the individual needs it, [then] it is possible to establish this which this baraita teaches, "but one may not clean [them] out," [as referring] to where the individual does not need it. However, if you establish that [ruling] of cleaning out [as referring] to where the individual does not need it, if so, this which it teaches, "but one may not clean [them] out," in what [case] do you establish it?

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:6:1.hebrew: אלא מאי בשיחיד צריך לו כו' - כלומר, במאי מוקמת האי דקתני חוטטין — בשרבים צריכים להן? והתניא כו', של רבים חופרין אותן:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:6:1.english: Rather, what [case is it]? Where an individual needs it, etc. - That is to say, in what [case] do you establish this [baraita] that teaches "one may clean out" — [is it] where the public needs them? But isn't it taught [in a baraita], etc., "[those] of the public, one may dig them"?

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:7:1.hebrew: אלא קשיא קמייתא - דקתני אין חופרין בורות של רבים בשרבים צריכין לו, קשיא להא ברייתא דקתני הכא של רבים חופרין אותן:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:7:1.english: But the first [baraita] is difficult - For it teaches: One may not dig cisterns of the public when the public needs it; [this] poses a difficulty for this baraita, which teaches here [that] those of the public, one may dig them.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:7:2.hebrew: אלא תריץ הכי - ואין צריך לומר בשל רבים, דאפילו חפירה מותר, ולא קשיא לרבי יוחנן דאמר לא שנו כו':
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:7:2.english: Rather, answer as follows - and needless to say [those] of the public, as even digging is permitted, and it is not difficult for Rabbi Yochanan, who said: "They only taught [this]," etc.

Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:9:1.hebrew: מתניתין נמי דיקא - דבשרבים צריכין לו, דחפירה נמי מותר:
Rashi on Moed Katan 5a:9:1.english: The Mishnah is also precise - [indicating] that when the public needs it, digging is also permitted.

Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:10:1.hebrew: לאתויי הך דתניא - קא סלקא דעתיה דהאי דקפריך הכא דבכלל "מתקנין הדרכים" לא הוי קוץ דרכים, דתיקון משמע שמתקן הגבשושיות והגומות, הלכך פריך הכי. ומתרץ: כל אלו בהדיא קתני להו, דהוו בכלל מתקנין כו'. א"נ: האי דמקשה הך קושיא לא היתה מתניתא שגורה בפיו, ולא הוי ידע דגרס בה "ומתקנין את הדרכים":
Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:10:1.english: "To include that which is taught [in the baraita]" - It entered the mind of this [sage] who objects here that clearing thorns from the roads is not included in "repairing the roads," for "repairing" implies that one repairs the bumps and the pits; therefore he objects thus. And [the Gemara] answers: All these are explicitly taught, as they are included in "repairing," etc. Alternatively: The one who raised this difficulty was not fluent in the Mishnah, and did not know that it reads, "and they repair the roads."

Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:11:1.hebrew: והיה עליך דמים - פי' רבינו חננאל: נקיט ליה להאי קרא מפרשת מעקה, דדמי להאי דהוי מכשול. ממתני' עם הגמרא יש ללמד שאסור להשקות קרקעות, אלא אותן דהוו דבר האבד שיתקלקלו התבואה והאילנות הנטועים בה; והוא הדין לשאר עבודת קרקע, אסור בחולו של מועד. והא דאמרינן דמותר להשקות — הני מילי כגון מאמת המים העוברת בשדה עצמו, דליכא טירחא יתירא. ומותר לתקן בורות, שיחין ומערות של יחיד, ושל רבים מותר לחפור לכתחילה, כיון דצריכי למים, דהכי תניא לעיל כדפרישית:
Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:11:1.english: "And so blood be upon you" - Rabbeinu Chananel explained: [The Gemara] cites this verse from the section of ma'akeh [the parapet], because it is similar to this [case], as it is a hazard. From the Mishnah together with the Gemara, it is to be learned that it is forbidden to irrigate lands, except for those that are a case of irretrievable loss (davar ha'aved), [where] the grain and the trees planted in it would be ruined; and the same applies to other agricultural work, [which] is forbidden on Chol HaMoed. And that which we say that it is permitted to irrigate — this applies, for example, from an irrigation channel that passes through the field itself, where there is no excessive exertion. And it is permitted to repair cisterns, ditches, and caves belonging to an individual, while those belonging to the public it is permitted to dig initially (lekhatchilah), since they are needed for water, as was taught above, as I have explained.

Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:13:1.hebrew: רמז לציון - דהאי קרא לא כתיב אלא לעתיד, אבל לא בזמן הזה; ומיהו משני דאיכא למילף מהתם:
Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:13:1.english: An allusion to marking - [It is called an "allusion"] because this verse is written only regarding the future, and not regarding the present time; however, [the Gemara] answers that one can learn [an allusion] from there.

Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:14:1.hebrew: הא מקמי דליתי יחזקאל - כלומר, לדידך דאמרת דבזמן הזה הוי מדאורייתא, אם כן מקמי דליתי יחזקאל הוה ליה להקדוש ברוך הוא לאשמועינן דצריך ציון. ומתרץ: הרבה דברים דקים לן דאסורין מן התורה, דלא כתיב בקרא אלא בהלכה עד דאתא יחזקאל, והאי הכי נמי:
Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:14:1.english: "Before Ezekiel came" - That is to say: According to you, who say that nowadays [marking graves] is biblical, if so, before Ezekiel came, the Holy One, blessed be He, should have informed us that a marker is required. And [Rav Ashi] answers: [There are] many things that we know are forbidden by the Torah, which are not written in Scripture, rather [they were transmitted] in the halakha [oral tradition] until Ezekiel came, and this [case] is also so.

Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:19:1.hebrew: רב פפא אמר סלו סלו - כל חד וחד נקיט מאי דהוה מסיק אדעתיה, ולא פליגי; אלא אורחיה דמלתא, דכל חד מסיק אדעתיה מאי דלא מסיק חבריה אדעתיה:
Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:19:1.english: Rav Pappa said: "Pave, pave" - Each and every one [of the Amoraim] took [as his proof] that which came to his mind, and they do not disagree; rather, it is the way of things that each one brings to mind that which his colleague does not bring to mind.

Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:24:1.hebrew: בשבתא דריגלא - שבת של יום הרגל, שהיו דורשין והיו מתקבצין כל בני העיר לשמוע הלכות של רגל:
Tosafot on Moed Katan 5a:24:1.english: On Shabbat of the Festival - A Shabbat of a Festival day, when they would deliver a public discourse and all the townspeople would gather to hear the laws of the Festival.
